visual_review.method: Author self-review of all three actual native raster outputs, compared with the read manuscript and rendered source pages; not an independent review.
checks: Main scientific objects replace repeated equal cards; central plants, roots, soil pools and organisms occupy the dominant region.
No fabricated numeric results, plot traces or claimed empirical rerun.
Main soil decomposition, mortality and mineralization directions corrected in the first edit.
Discussion-only options are disconnected from the Euler integration input.
No-chemical case retains living organisms; chemical mortality terms are turned off.
Main root uptake and top-level model progression inspected; labels are legible at native display size.
issues: The long 5-to-7 feeding link is labeled but still runs behind/near the bird. The separate 6-to-7 link is not visually unambiguous. Nine intended matrix edges must not be reported as all visually verified.
Fertilizer has a disconnected small brace rather than sharing the clear crops-present gate with both pesticide rows. Replace with explicit row-level condition labels before publication.
Forest inset uses a teal decomposition link and a partly recolored uptake curve; local color semantics should be unified before publication.
Illustrative grass at the soil surface is scenery rather than an additional state. A publication revision may remove it to reduce biological ambiguity.
Actual print-size proof and independent scientific review were not performed. The image is a style trial, not an accepted publication figure.

approval_evidence.scope: This scene-based image and bilingual project showcase; not scientific validation or source-library admission.

scope: File integrity only; not source fidelity, image quality or scientific publication readiness.
